categories.description: The customer is blocked or losing money and someone must act: order missing, wrong, damaged or defective; no order confirmation; refund or payment problem (e.g. charged twice); support not responding to an open problem. Classify by the FACTS, not the tone - a polite message can still be critical.
The customer is unhappy (quality, speed, website, general experience) but nothing is blocking them and no action is required to unblock an order or payment.
Positive or neutral feedback, or a general question with no problem reported.

assignments.name: urgency_reason
assignments.value: ={{ $json.issue_type === 'Critical issue' && ($json.sentiment_category === 'Negative' && $json.sentiment_strength >= 0.85 && $json.sentiment_confidence >= 0.85) ? 'Critical issue + very negative' : $json.issue_type === 'Critical issue' ? 'Critical issue (blocked customer)' : ($json.sentiment_category === 'Negative' && $json.sentiment_strength >= 0.85 && $json.sentiment_confidence >= 0.85) ? 'Very negative (strength & confidence >= 0.85)' : 'Below urgency threshold' }}
